name: Database card
description: Cylindrical DB illustration whose fill level tracks a 'load' metric (e.g. connection-pool utilisation), with QPS and p99 latency stats alongside.

spec.template:
Load{{ format load.value 'percent' 0 }}
QPS{{ format qps.value 'ops' 1 }}
p99{{ format p99.value 'ms' 0 }}
spec.styles: .db { display: flex; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; height: 100%; align-items: center; } .db svg { height: 100%; max-height: 9rem; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .db svg .outline { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: 0.7; } .db svg .top { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 15%, transparent); stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.2; opacity: 0.85; } .db svg .bottom { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.2; opacity: 0.5; } .db svg .fill { fill: var(--color-ember-500); transition: y 600ms ease-out; opacity: 0.85; } .db .stats { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .db .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .db .label { font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .db .row strong { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .db .vellum-th-ok { color: var(--color-sage-600); } .db .vellum-th-warn { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .db .vellum-th-bad { color: var(--color-rust-600); }
